messages:
nina: quick discover — a handful of billing mismatches traced to attribution key drift when tokenizers append runtime suffixes (e.g. `#v3`). we lose joins for long sessions.
sam: can you paste a minimal trace?
nina: sanitized: ```ingest:{sid:s-9,f:fp9,attr:tenant-17} tokenizer:{sid:s-9,f:fp9,attr:tenant-17#v3} billing:{sid:s-9,f:fp9,attr:tenant-17}``` join failed b/c of `#v3`.
jordan: is this only on the async tokenizer path?
nina: yes, async parallel tokenizers add heuristic suffixes to avoid collisions. ingest currently treats attribution as opaque.
tara: do we reliably have provenance_id to use as a canonical join?
evan: not always. it's optional for older clients and chunked flows sometimes skip it.
sam: three quick approaches: 1) canonicalize attribution in ingest (strip suffix) — simple but adds CPU to hot path and needs broad deploy. 2) tokenizer emits `canonical_attr` + publishes `attr-mapping` to audit topic — keeps ingest light. 3) reconcile offline via fingerprint+session — brittle.
jordan: (1) needs a canary plan across many services. (2) seems clean: produces immutable mapping events usable for audits.
ops-bot: deploy-note: changes to ingest hot-path require canary across ~12 services. :warning:
tara: for compliance we should always emit an immutable mapping event (`from -> to`) so replays can deterministically reconcile.
nina: proposal: adopt (2): tokenizer computes stable `canonical_attr`, includes it in tokenizer output, and emits a small mapping event to `audit.attr-maps`. ingest will persist canonical_attr if present; otherwise mark event `needs-mapping` and push to postprocess queue.
evan: tradeoffs: added fanout and storage vs keeping ingest latency low. also gives better offline auditability. +1 from me.
sam: i'll spike the mapping-event schema and run a qps/latency probe. will also draft suggested retention for `audit.attr-maps`.
jordan: i'll build the postprocess consumer to reconcile late mappings and add metrics for unmapped-rate and reconcile-lag.
tara: i'll write a short playbook for audit/replay steps and how to run one-off ledger fixes.
nina: can we aim for spike + playbook by EOW?
sam: yes. i'll post results here and include a canary/rollback plan if ingest behavior is touched. :thumbsup:
